design: default arm x the first-run pilot's 30 held-out Gmail tasks x replicates 0 and 1; single worker, seeded random order; profile prereg9 (180 s clock); compared with the pilot's 2 G_14 runs

registered_reading.primary: mean(d) with one-sided 95% bound, d_t = G14_t - default_t, both arms 30-step rescored

disclosure.step_cap: The pilot G_14 episodes (2026-10-09) ran effectively UNCAPPED (the 30-step cap bug was fixed on 2026-10-10 in src/cold_start/tasks/webarena.py); the default episodes run NOW with the 30-step cap enforced. The PRIMARY analysis therefore scores BOTH arms at the 30-step rescore (study.rescore(outcomes, 30): success and not timed_out and steps <= 30, the glk30 rule). The as-collected comparison (uncapped G_14 vs capped default) is SECONDARY and confounded.
disclosure.time_gap: G_14 pilot episodes ran 2026-10-09; the default episodes run after 2026-10-12 (frozen date). Provider/model drift between the two runs is not controlled; the noise recheck (2026-10-11) bounds how large rerun noise is, not drift.
disclosure.june_baseline: These 30 tasks were also run in June 2026 as part of the gmail_paired12 baseline (12 hand-written prompts, results/audit/matrices/gmail_paired12.csv), long before G_14 was selected. They were not used to select G_14 or to define the default; disclosed for completeness.
